Otherwise bully from the first minute: Q poke sets the tone.

Keep the stun for his engage: E held is E feared.
Bully plus poke-R: the Ekko who never stabilized never threatens.

tips.text: Concede the early trade war: his sustain wins HP races.
Do not stand still: every rooted second is his engage.
Break every trade with E: stun and walk away is the whole pattern.
Keep E for his engage attempts: with no E ready you have no disengage.
You are fine in teamfights if he is not fed: survive lane, win game, and never eat a stray R.

guides.favoredWhen: His E goes over your stun. Keep the wave on your side, punish only wasted Qs, and outscale.

Punish only clear mistakes, like a wasted Q: patience is the plan.
Track his E dashes: each spent E is seconds you can breathe.
Outscale: the lane you drew is the game you win.

guides.favoredWhen: The 1v1 favors you, but her level 6 gank setup does not. Lead early, ward at 6.

keyTips.text: The 1v1 favors you: take the duel when it is offered.

Bank the lead before 6: the setup lands on schedule.
At 6, wards before aggression: no vision means no walk-up.
Respect the 6-setup, not her damage: the jungler is the threat.
Early lead plus 6 survived: the Aurora who never converted setup loses.

guides.favoredWhen: Edge the small lead and outscale. Block QQ with creeps, dodge the wave nukes, call ganks.

keyTips.text: Strong laner, but you edge a small lead and outscale: play for edges.
Stand behind creeps to block QQ: minions are your shield.
Stay far when he nukes the wave: QE and EE are not yours to contest.

tips.text: Rush tier-2 boots: dodge volume beats poke volume.
He is weak in early skirmishes: call the 2v2, not the 1v1.
He is very gankable: ganks pay, so set them up.
Keep the small lead growing: outscale is the plan, not the all-in.
Edges plus ganks plus outscale: the strong laner who never snowballed loses.

keyTips.text: Treat lane as a Q skillshot test: landing Dark Sphere pushes opponents off the wave, while a careless E leaves a window they can punish.
At level six, leave two spheres on the ground and open with E into the stun; after earlier poke, the ultimate can then threaten the kill.
Arrive early for dragon to chunk opponents or secure a pick, then use Syndra's zone control to make the enemy approach painful.

tips.text: Play for a lead through CS first and a solo kill second, using Syndra's strong lane and scaling rather than forcing constant fights.
In lane, prioritize the two-sphere E stun into the level-six burst.
Open Doran's Ring with two Health Potions to support the Q-poke plan.
Farm side waves and nearby camps to keep CS high and accelerate item income, balancing that income against reaching objectives on time.
With Teleport up, push side waves before grouping; without vision, stop short of extending where Syndra can be caught.
In fights, either finish a vulnerable carry with Unleashed Power or use the sphere setup to land a wide stun for the team.
Save E for the moment it can interrupt a key enemy engage, since getting engaged on is Syndra's main danger.
Position carefully and play more cautiously without Flash; strong objective setup plus a well-placed stun is how Syndra's teamfight wins happen.

itemization.text: Run Arcane Comet with Manaflow Band, Transcendence, Scorch, Legend: Haste, and Cut Down to pair with the Q-poke plan.

Build Blackfire Torch into Sorcerer's Shoes, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, and Zhonya's Hourglass, or the Stormsurge, Sorcerer's Shoes, Imperial Mandate, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Shadowflame second path; add Mercury's Treads into double AP and crowd control.

Keep Mejai's Soulstealer for snowballs, Morellonomicon for healing, Banshee's Veil for safety, Liandry's Torment for long fights, Horizon Focus for zone control, and Luden's Echo as further options by game need.
